firm_data.firm_description: Gersowitz Libo & Korek, P.C. is a personal injury law firm based in New York City that fights for the rights of individuals, recovering tens of millions of dollars for clients in New York and New Jersey.
notable_facts: Recognized as one of the leading personal injury law firms in the area.
The firm was recognized by the National Law Journal for achieving the #1 and #4 top verdicts in the country for an $18 million settlement and a $12 million settlement respectively.

email.subject: AI for Gersowitz Libo & Korek - built for firms like yours
email.body:
Hi Edward,

Your firm's track record recovering tens of millions for clients across New York and New Jersey is exactly why we reached out. Firms at your scale handling complex personal injury cases need the precision and efficiency that most legal AI simply doesn't deliver.

I lead business at Lucio, an AI platform built for law firms that face BigLaw demands with leaner teams. We recently raised $5M, and firms across 9 jurisdictions have chosen us over Harvey because we focus on the realities of smaller practices: precision, client trust, and efficiency.

Having completed successful pilots on the East Coast, we're now meeting regional firms to show how ex-lawyers like us are helping shops compete with BigLaw. I'd be happy to stop by your office to share how this works for personal injury teams specifically.

Worth 20 minutes?

Vasu
Lucio
